publication.title: Facilitating entity navigation through top-K link patterns

source_reading.scope: Abstract/scope, metric definitions, full prototype/user study/runtime evaluation and conclusion (§§4–6).

adjudication.basis: SView’s Link module implements single-entity and entity-set RDF navigation through ranked link patterns, with filtering and follow-up browsing. A 24-person comparison documents both benefits and drawbacks of labels, history and target coverage.

codes.notes: SView top-K link patterns represent relation/cardinality conditions. Long labels,target loss and poor rollback reported despite benefits. No unstated remote query protocol inferred.

report_level_evaluation.design: Each uses SView, OpenLink Faceted Search & Find and Rhizomer in randomized order; four tasks per system from different random starting entities, 20-minute tutorial and 10-minute free use.
report_level_evaluation.results: Not reported; limits: Different starting entities can differ in task difficulty; small student cohort. Three system conditions are not 72 unique participants; pattern-distribution entity sets are not users. SView benefited link organization while comparators had clearer labels/history.
report_level_evaluation.limitations: Not reported: tasks, comparator, results. Different starting entities can differ in task difficulty; small student cohort.
